searchPlaceholder.en: Search GEO tools, features, or categories…
searchPlaceholder.zh: 搜索 GEO 工具、功能或分类…

searchHint.en: Find your next tool for AI visibility, citations, and GEO.
searchHint.zh: 发现适合你的 AI 曝光监控、引用追踪与 GEO 工具。

heroTitle.zh: 发现值得关注的 GEO 工具

heroDescription.en: Discover and compare AI search visibility tools.
heroDescription.zh: 发现和比较 AI 搜索曝光工具。

eyebrow.zh: 面向 AI 搜索的工具目录

browseHint.en: A focused collection. A clearer starting point.
browseHint.zh: 专注 GEO，帮你找到清晰的起点。

brandDescription.zh: 发现优质 GEO 工具。

editorial.zh: 独立编辑整理 · 信息来源可查

sourceNote.en: Checked against official product information. This is a source review, not a hands-on test. Features and plans may change.
sourceNote.zh: 依据官方产品资料核验，未进行实际使用测试。功能与方案可能变化。

pricingNote.en: Check the vendor for current plans and limits. A free trial is not a free plan.
pricingNote.zh: 最新方案和限制请以官网为准。免费试用不等于永久免费。

unknownPlatforms.en: See the official product documentation for current coverage.
unknownPlatforms.zh: 当前支持范围请查看官方产品文档。

noResultsHint.en: Try a product name, a feature like citations, or browse a category.
noResultsHint.zh: 试试产品名称、“引用”等功能词，或按分类浏览。

emptySearchHint.en: Enter a tool name, feature, or category to get started.
emptySearchHint.zh: 输入工具名、功能或分类开始搜索。

affiliate.en: This is an affiliate link. We may earn a commission if you sign up or purchase, at no extra cost to you.
affiliate.zh: 此链接为联盟链接。如果你注册或购买，我们可能获得佣金，你无需额外支付费用。

submitTitle.en: Know a tool we should include?
submitTitle.zh: 有值得收录的 GEO 工具？

submitIntro.en: Help make the directory more useful. Tell us about a tool built for AI search.
submitIntro.zh: 推荐与 AI 搜索相关的工具，帮助我们完善目录。

submitNote.en: Your email app will open with a draft. You must send the email yourself. Every submission is reviewed before publication.
submitNote.zh: 提交后会打开邮件客户端草稿，请自行发送邮件。所有推荐均经审核后发布。

noEmail.en: No email app? Download the JSON and email it to
noEmail.zh: 没有邮件客户端？下载 JSON 后发送至

reviewText.en: We check relevance, official sources, and duplicate listings. Submitting a tool does not guarantee inclusion or priority placement.
reviewText.zh: 我们会核验相关性、官方资料与重复收录情况。提交不保证收录或优先展示。

duplicate.en: This website is already in the directory. Explore the existing listing or contact us with an update.
duplicate.zh: 该网站已被收录。请查看现有条目，或通过邮件提供更新。

prepared.en: Email draft requested. Send it in your email app to complete your submission. If it did not open, download the JSON below.
prepared.zh: 已请求打开邮件草稿，请在邮件客户端发送以完成推荐。如未打开，可下载下方 JSON。

downloaded.en: Submission downloaded. Email the file to our contact address for review.
downloaded.zh: 推荐资料已下载，请将文件发送至联系邮箱以供审核。

invalidUrl.en: Enter a valid public http:// or https:// website address.
invalidUrl.zh: 请输入有效的公开 http:// 或 https:// 官网地址。

notFound.en: This page is off the map.

notFoundText.en: The link may have changed. Let’s find your way back to the directory.
notFoundText.zh: 链接可能已变更，返回目录继续发现工具。

contactTitle.zh: 一起完善这个工具目录。

contactIntro.en: Found outdated information, have a question, or want to discuss a partnership? Email us.
contactIntro.zh: 发现资料过时、有疑问，或希望洽谈合作？欢迎通过邮件联系。

contactSubmit.en: Recommending a tool? Use the submission form so we have the details to review.
contactSubmit.zh: 推荐新工具？请使用提交表单提供待审核资料。

partnersEmpty.zh: 我们正在寻找有价值的连接。

partnersIntro.en: Explore online tools and AI resources. For editorial partnerships, get in touch.
partnersIntro.zh: 发现实用的在线工具与 AI 资讯资源。内容合作请通过邮件联系。

independent.zh: 按相关性整理，不设虚构评分。

mailPrivacy.en: This form does not upload or store your data. Email is handled by your email provider.
mailPrivacy.zh: 此表单不会上传或存储资料；邮件由你的邮件服务商处理。

cookieIntro.en: We use necessary storage to remember your choice. With your permission, Google Analytics cookies help us understand how this directory is used.
cookieIntro.zh: 我们使用必要存储记住你的选择。经你同意后，Google Analytics Cookie 才会帮助我们了解目录的使用情况。

cookieDescription.en: Choose whether to allow visit analytics. Your choice applies to both languages on this site and is saved for 180 days. You can change it anytime in the footer.
cookieDescription.zh: 选择是否允许访问分析。你的选择在本站中英页面共用，保存 180 天，可随时通过页脚修改。

cookieNecessaryDescription.en: Local storage remembers your Cookie preferences. It is not used to track your visits.
cookieNecessaryDescription.zh: 本地存储用于记住 Cookie 偏好，不用于追踪访问行为。

cookieAnalyticsDescription.en: Helps us understand page views, traffic sources, searches and tool link clicks. No Google analytics requests are sent unless you allow this. Advertising tracking stays off.
cookieAnalyticsDescription.zh: 帮助我们了解浏览量、流量来源、搜索及工具外链点击。仅在你同意后向 Google 发送统计请求；广告追踪始终关闭。

cookieWithdrawal.en: Turning off visit analytics refreshes this page to stop the loaded tag.
cookieWithdrawal.zh: 关闭已启用的访问分析时，页面会刷新以停止统计代码。

cookieSession.en: Browser storage is unavailable. Your choice applies only to this page; you will be asked again on your next visit.
cookieSession.zh: 浏览器存储不可用，选择仅对当前页面有效，下次访问时将重新询问。
